## Description

Helpers in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]
for the asymptotic covariance matrix of the sample covariance matrix
under the multivariate normal distribution,
and for the sample covariance matrix of the data.
Each function has an internal version without input checks
that other projects can copy.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `gammaN` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/gammaN) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/gammaN")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "gammaN")
```

The asymptotic covariance matrix of the half-vectorized sample covariance matrix of two variables under normality.

```{r}
x <- datasets::mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt")]
GammaN(x = x)
GammaN(x = x, consistent = FALSE)
```
